approved.en: Ukraine has resumed missile strikes on Russian oil refineries and a missile-maintenance base, while the UK is sending additional Storm Shadow missiles for further attacks on Russia. Russian drones have attacked ships in the Black Sea near Romania, leaving seven crew members missing, and have disrupted health supply shipments in Ukraine. Kyiv blames SpaceX for throttling Starlink terminals that support its drone operations. Russia has detained a Japanese journalist on espionage charges. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Ukraina har gjenopptatt missilangrep mot russiske oljeraffinerier og en missilvedlikeholdsbase, mens Storbritannia sender flere Storm Shadow-missiler for ytterligere angrep på Russland. Russiske droner har angrepet skip i Svartehavet nær Romania, og syv besetningsmedlemmer er savnet, og har forstyrret leveranser av helsesuppler i Ukraina. Kyiv anklager SpaceX for å dempe Starlink-terminaler som støtter deres dronoperasjoner. Russland har fengslet en japansk journalist på spionasjebeskyldning. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israel has stopped commercial goods from entering Gaza while Hamas denies tax allegations, and Israeli forces killed a Palestinian woman in Gaza City and rescued a girl from a burning apartment. Iran saw two container ships sink near the Strait of Hormuz amid a surge in Iranian attacks, a development linked to the broader regional tension over Gaza. Azerbaijan hosted a rare summit that brought together both converging and opposing Middle East and Asian leaders, including Israeli and Palestinian representatives. The UCDP recorded 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iran så to containerskip synke nær Hormuzstredet i en periode med økt iransk aktivitet, en utvikling knyttet til den bredere regionale spenningen rundt Gaza. Aserbajdsjan var vertskap for et sjeldent toppmøte som samlet både konvergerende og motstridende ledere fra Midtøsten og Asia, inkludert israelske og palestinske representanter. UCDP registrerte 21 440 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized in two Lebanese trucks have prompted Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation, while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel, a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, leading the IDF chief to order a probe and authorities to consider restricting hikes. Students on the same hike fashioned tourniquets from belts and socks after the blast. Hezbollah announced compensation for Lebanese homeowners whose houses were destroyed and unveiled an aid plan for displaced civilians. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024.
approved.nb: Hezbollah-eksplosiver som ble beslaglagt i to libanesiske lastebiler har fått Libanons statsminister og sikkerhetsstyrker til å love en grundig etterforskning, mens israelsk artilleri og luftangrep fortsetter mot Hezbollah-posisjoner i sørlige Libanon, og forårsaker sivile tap. I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk under en fottur nær Libanongränsen, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som fikk IDF-sjefen til å beordre en undersøkelse og myndighetene til å vurdere restriksjoner på fotturer. Studenter på samme tur laget tourniquetter av belter og sokker etter eksplosjonen. Hezbollah kunngjorde erstatning til libanesiske huseiere hvis hus ble ødelagt og presenterte en hjelpsplan for fortrengte sivile. UCDP registrerte 4 335 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024.

approved.en: Houthi missiles have struck Yemen's presidential palace in Aden, killing five officials, and have also hit Saudi-led forces headquarters there and a Saudi airport, prompting Saudi air strikes on Houthi positions in Yemen. Iran has sunk two container ships in the Strait of Hormuz, increasing the threat to regional shipping, and its precision strikes have damaged Gulf infrastructure. Saudi diplomats say Iran is encouraging Houthi escalation against the kingdom. US officials are reportedly weighing the use of the "mother of all bombs" if fighting resumes. The conflict recorded 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Houthis launched missile strikes on Yemen’s presidential palace in Aden, killing five ministers and hitting the Saudi-led forces headquarters located there. The attacks were part of a broader pattern of Houthi targeting of Saudi coalition command centres in the city. Simultaneously, migrants continue risking sea journeys to reach Yemen, while a besieged Yemeni city faces severe food and fuel shortages as Houthis press forward. The conflict produced 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Angrepene var en del av et bredere mønster der houthiene har rettet seg mot Saudi-koalisjonens kommandosentre i byen. Samtidig fortsetter migranter å risikere sjøreiser for å nå Jemen, mens en beleiret jemenisk by står overfor alvorlige mat- og drivstoffmangel etter hvert som houthiene presser frem. Konflikten førte til 918 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Syrian security forces arrested militia leader Mihrac Ural for the 2013 Baniyas massacre and sentenced two individuals to death for the 2025 coastal sectarian violence, while another pair received death sentences for related clashes. A gas export pipeline in northeastern Syria was attacked, sparking a fire. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu disclosed a direct conversation with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa about Druze violence. Qatari and Syrian interior ministers deepened security cooperation in Damascus. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

En gasseksportpipeline i nordøstlige Syria ble angrepet, noe som førte til brann. Israels statsminister Netanyahu opplyste om en direkte samtale med Syriens president Ahmed al-Sharaa om drusisk vold. De qatarske og syriske innenriksministrene styrket sikkerhetssamarbeidet i Damaskus. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iraq's parliament has appointed US-sanctioned Laith al-Khazali as deputy prime minister, signaling continued political influence of sanctioned figures. Iraqi authorities have publicly pledged that Iraqi territory will not be used for attacks on Saudi Arabia, while Kataib Hezbollah warned it will target hostile aircraft over Iraq. Security forces have dismantled two human-trafficking networks, rescuing newborns, and foiled a ring selling infants. ISIS activity appears to be regrouping in Iraq following the US withdrawal. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iraks myndigheter har offentlig lovet at irakisk territorium ikke vil bli brukt til angrep på Saudi-Arabia, mens Kataib Hezbollah har advart om at de vil treffe fiendtlige fly over Irak. Sikkerhetsstyrker har oppløst to menneskehandelsnettverk, reddet nyfødte, og avverget et nettverk som solgte spedbarn. IS-aktivitet ser ut til å samle seg igjen i Irak etter USAs tilbaketrekning. Konflikten registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Sudanese Armed Forces have launched air strikes on gold mining sites near the Sudan-Egypt border, killing dozens of miners, while the Rapid Support Forces used a paramilitary drone to strike near the Ethiopian frontier, causing civilian casualties in West Kordofan. In the Blue Nile, the Sudanese army repelled a joint RSF and SPLM-N attack, inflicting heavy losses on the attackers. Doctors in Sudan report worsening detention conditions for more than 6,500 people held by the RSF. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Blå Nil avviste hæren et felles angrep fra RSF og SPLM-N, og påførte angriperne store tap. Leger i Sudan rapporterer om forverrede forhold i fengsler for mer enn 6 500 personer som holdes av RSF. Konflikten førte til 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

UNMISS has stepped up civilian protection after deadly attacks in Rumbek, while SSPDF soldiers were wounded in an assault on a Mundri West military outpost and the U.S. Embassy condemned an assault on WFP workers in Jonglei that involved looting of aid. An AIC cleric was shot dead in Juba and a Juba High Court sentenced five officers to 24 years for raiding a general's home. The lethal communal violence now far exceeds the two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have captured a key town in Tigray along with its regional airport and are advancing toward an Eritrean border town, while intense fighting in Amhara has left at least 183 dead, according to the UN. The United States has increased diplomatic pressure, urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate as the conflict spreads. Leaders of Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan and Somalia are meeting to coordinate security operations if the fighting crosses borders. The war caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA har økt diplomatisk press og oppfordrer Etiopia og Eritrea til å de-eskalere ettersom konflikten sprer seg. Ledere fra Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan og Somalia møtes for å koordinere sikkerhetsoperasjoner dersom kampene krysser grenser. Krigen forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharin forces are consolidating control of the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces claim to have captured Buurhakaba after heavy fighting in the Bay region, and fighters loyal to a former regional president have also seized Burhakaba. The Somali government is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case and is hosting regional talks in Egypt with Eritrea, Sudan and its own officials to coordinate security amid rising Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions. The federal government is deepening defence ties with Pakistan, seeking JF‑17 fighter jets and securing the release of four Pakistani sailors freed from Somali pirates. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den somaliske regjeringen screener reisende etter at Kenya bekreftet et importert ebolatilfelle, og den er vert for regionale samtaler i Egypt med Eritrea, Sudan og egne tjenestemenn for å koordinere sikkerheten midt i økende spenninger mellom Etiopia og Eritrea. Den føderale regjeringen utdyper forsvarssamarbeidet med Pakistan, søker JF‑17‑jagerfly og sikrer løslatelsen av fire pakistanske sjømenn som ble frigjort fra somaliske pirater. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Gunmen attacked an immigration patrol in Niger State, killing one officer and wounding another, and also burned the officer's body. Bandits carried out a separate assault in Borgu LGA, while a Christian humanitarian worker was slain in northwest Nigeria and a Niger lawyer was jailed for a social-media post about the army. The United States added Nigeria to its blacklist for recruiting child soldiers, and Mali expanded its reserve force by 2,400 recruits, including 800 women. These incidents show a widening of violence beyond isolated attacks on security forces to include civilian targets and legal repression. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

The coalition’s formation expands the rebel alliance beyond M23 alone. The conflict remains deadly, with 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
